D: A wooden puppet brought to life has to prove himself brave, truthful and unselfish to become a real boy.
P: Serve the mains when Pinocchio finds Geppetto inside the whale.
S: Geppetto's workshop full of clocks and toys

Little toasts of salami, provolone and a slice of pickled capsicum, laid out on a wooden board. Slice a baguette thinly, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until crisp. Top each toast with a fold of salami, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum. Lay them out in rows on a wooden board like tools on a bench.

Little fried ring doughnuts tossed hot in cinnamon sugar and served in paper bags with a warm caramel sauce for dipping. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll out 1cm thick and cut 20 small rings. Prove 20 minutes, then fry at 175C for 1 minute a side until golden. Toss hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve in paper bags with warm caramel sauce.
Cheddar cracker dough cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.
M: Geppetto fishing inside Monstro the whale

Whole snapper stuffed with lemon, garlic and parsley, roasted until the skin crisps, with golden roast potatoes and salsa verde. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil at 220C for 20 minutes. Score a 1.5kg whole snapper 3 times on each side, rub with olive oil and salt and stuff with lemon slices, 3 garlic cloves and parsley. Lay it on top of the potatoes and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until the flesh flakes. Chop a bunch of parsley with 1 tbsp capers, lemon zest and 80ml olive oil for the salsa verde.

Beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley browned, then simmered 40 minutes in a slow tomato and basil sauce, served over spaghetti with extra parmesan. Mix 600g beef mince with grated parmesan, chopped parsley, salt and an egg, roll into balls and brown well. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, crushed garlic and torn basil and simmer for 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti with extra parmesan grated on top.
W: the Blue Fairy granting the wish
Sweet pastry filled with vanilla custard and topped with blueberries, glazed and dusted with icing sugar.
K: Lime, mint and honey muddled together and topped with sparkling water over crushed ice, bright green and fresh like a cricket. In a jug, muddle 2 big handfuls of mint leaves with 4 tbsp honey and the juice of 4 limes until the mint is bruised and fragrant. Add 250ml cold apple juice and stir. Fill 4 small glasses with crushed ice, pour in the mix to halfway and top with sparkling water. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a mint sprig.

Rub 100g butter into 150g flour, then mix in 150g grated cheddar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Add a splash of cold water to bring it together and chill for 30 minutes. Roll thin, cut into fish shapes and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case until golden and cool completely. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard and pile 250g blueberries on top. Warm 2 tbsp apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over the berries to glaze. Dust with icing sugar and chill.
